comparison.objective: Fill three drywall nail holes with spackle and strike them flush; unlike dry-media screening.
comparison.physical_skill: Loading and angling a putty knife, packing viscous material, and flush surface finishing versus bimanual screen handling and granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Grades filled-hole depth, limited proud area, avoided face damage, knife set-down, and dwell; no selective passage or mass-recovery criterion. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: It tests tool-mediated surface filling and finishing, not sorting or recovery of rigid components.
